$comment: The rendered geometry guard for the spacing floor (owner, 2026-11-04, #617), as data a browser audit reads (mzizi-site's scripts/audit-ui.mjs --guard, the CLI's check). This registry has no browser harness of its own (scripts/kitesurf.ts is a remote text probe), so the guard is specified here once and run where a browser exists. Numbers equal BUNDU_FLOOR.spacing (pinned by __tests__/spacing-floor.test.ts).

measure.say: Neighbouring interactive controls keep 7px between their VISIBLE edges. Hit regions (the ::after of the hit-area rule) may touch but must not overlap a sibling's visible box.
measure.select: button, [role=button], [role=tab], a[href], input:not([type=hidden]), select, textarea, summary
measure.rule: for each pair of controls that share a parent, distance(visibleRect(a), visibleRect(b)) >= controlGapPx unless they are one joined group ([role=group] / [role=toolbar] with data-joined)

measure.say: A label and its field keep 7px.
measure.rule: distance(rect(label), rect(label.control)) >= labelGapPx unless the control is inside the label

measure.say: Sibling items of a list, grid, stack or toolbar keep 7px.
measure.rule: distance between consecutive children's rects >= itemGapPx, unless the container sets data-spacing-exception

measure.say: Text keeps 14px from the edge of its container: inline for a control's label, both axes for a card, panel, dialog, alert or popover.
measure.rule: min distance from the text range's rect to the content-box edge of the nearest ancestor that draws an edge (background, border, ring or shadow) >= insetPx, inline axis only for a control

measure.say: Body text sets no line height tighter than 1.5.
measure.select: p, li, dd, blockquote, figcaption, td, th

stress.$comment: WCAG 1.4.12 Text Spacing: apply this, then assert nothing is clipped (scrollWidth <= clientWidth and scrollHeight <= clientHeight on every element with overflow hidden/clip) and nothing overflows its container, and that the measure rules above still hold.
